title: HDB Flats Resold to HDB in Past Five Years
what_it_is: HDB Flats Resold to HDB in Past Five Years

sections.label: Flats surrendered to HDB
sections.summary: About 1,700 flats were surrendered to HDB in five years, about half 2-room and about 1,000 short-lease flats.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In the past five years, about 1,700 flats were surrendered to the Housing and Development Board (HDB).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Of these flats, about half were 2-room flats, one-sixth were 3-room flats and one-third were 4-room or larger flats.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: About 1,000 of the surrendered flats were short-lease flats, comprising Studio Apartments, 2-room Flexi flats bought on a short lease, and flats whose owners had opted for the Lease Buyback Scheme.

sections.label: Surrendered flats and HDB penalty
sections.summary: The remaining 700 flats were surrendered mostly due to changed circumstances, with divorce and marriage annulment common reasons.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The remaining 700 flats were surrendered to HDB mostly due to changes in the owners’ circumstances within their Minimum Occupation Period, which rendered them ineligible to own an HDB flat.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The most common reasons for surrender of flats were divorce, break-up of fiancé-fiancée relationship and annulment of marriage.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HDB compensates flat owners for the surrendered flats, and offers them for sale through the Sale of Balance Flats (SBF) exercises.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: If the flats remain unselected after the SBF exercise, they may then be made available under open booking.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: I just wanted to ask the Senior Minister State this: I understand that for flats that are returned to HDB, HDB imposes a penalty of 5% on the value of the flat.
